title: 邓白氏查全球 MCP 对接配置
description: 连接您的邓白氏 Direct+ 账号，用于查询全球企业档案、风险洞察、企业关联及受益所有人等商业洞察。Access Token 仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录下，不会上传至云端。
description_en: Connect your D&B Direct+ account to access global company profiles, risk insights, corporate linkages, and UBO data. Your Access Token is stored locally in ~/.workbuddy only and is never uploaded to the cloud.
docLabel: 如何获取 D&B Access Token？
docLabel_en: How to get D&B Access Token?

fields.label: D&B Access Token
fields.placeholder: 在邓白氏 Direct+ 开发者控制台或 邓白氏查全球登录页面生成 Access Token 后粘贴至此
fields.placeholder_en: Generate an Access Token from the D&B Direct+ Developer Console or D&B Global Search login page, then paste it here.
fields.description: 用于访问邓白氏查全球 MCP 的 Bearer Token。请确保 Token 具有 MCP 及所需数据块的访问权限。
fields.description_en: Bearer token for the D&B Global Search MCP service. Ensure the token has access to MCP and the required datablocks.
